target.statement: ATBTSGM achieves 100% precision, recall, and F1-score on Dataset B (2 hp) of the CWRU bearing dataset.
target.dataset: CWRU Bearing Dataset (2 hp subset, Dataset B)

compute.basis: No code is provided; the method requires implementing entropy-based segmentation, DTW graph construction, GAT+LSTM model, and K-fold cross-validation from scratch, plus downloading and preprocessing CWRU data; training on ~120k samples is feasible on CPU but time-consuming.

blockers: No code or implementation details released
Data availability statement says 'upon reasonable request' though CWRU is publicly available
Exact preprocessing (segmentation, window size, threshold) not fully specified
Graph construction with DTW over many segments may be computationally heavy
title: Spatial-Temporal Bearing Fault Detection Using Graph Attention Networks and LSTM
